about_the_game:
Step into the dark world of 2147, a dystopian place of vampires, androids, and you, trapped in between

You are Lina, a young woman searching frantically for your twin brother, who vanished the night he was transformed into a vampire. 
Stepping out from the safety of home, you find yourself in a city where danger lies in every shadow. With clues to lead you to the truth, you'll uncover secrets that threaten not only your brother - but the very balance of the world itself.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The new humans may look like ordinary people, but beneath their polished exterior lies cold machinery. They call themselves the city's protectors, maintaining order through constant surveillance and binding residents with digital communication rings. They know far too much about you - and this knowledge might lead you to your brother... unless they choose to use it against you.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The true vampires are enemies from your past - immensely powerful and ruling over a part of the city beyond the reach of the new humans. Any encounter with them could easily end your life. Yet, they may hold the key to discovering your brother’s whereabouts.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Bound by blood and ancient rituals, the cult of Mare shares your vampire lineage, Crustallus. But their rituals hide sinister truths, and their loyalty could be fleeting. Why are so many of their own disappearing? Can you trust them, or will their secrets pull you deeper into darkness?

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Time is running out. Will you uncover the truth behind your brother’s disappearance, or become another lost soul in the shadows of 2147? The choice is yours.

Features:

This horror visual novel is primarily aimed at women, though of course everyone is welcome to play!

  • Set your own name: You can choose the name of the protagonist.

  • Branching Narrative: Make difficult decisions that have wide-ranging effects and several possible outcomes in a story spanning roughly 90.000 words.

  • Multiple endings: 27 endings can be unlocked in the ending gallery.

  • (Toxic) Romance: You can pursue Saul, Damien, or Cain. But be careful, they are not exactly green flags...

  • Three Paths: Join the cult of Mare, the new humans, or the true vampires; each group has its own secrets and difficulties. But watch out - no route is free of sacrifice.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features frequent graphic depictions of violence and gore. It contains themes of drug use and suicide. General adult content. Player discretion is advised.

short_description: Year 2147: In a city where androids and vampires rule, you're caught in the crossfire. Searching for your lost twin, who will you trust - and what are you willing to sacrifice? Every choice decides your fate - for better or worse - within this dark visual novel with multiple endings.
